notes: LeetCode-style task with a Go stub; the language selector is set to Go. Criteria, not defects: coverage = how fully the answer satisfies each.

findings.title: Correct O(n) algorithm
findings.detail: Sliding window with a last-seen index per character (or a set with a moving left bound); single pass, O(n) time.

findings.title: Left bound never moves backwards
findings.detail: left = max(left, last[c]+1) (or equivalent). Without the max, input like "abba" gives a wrong answer.

findings.title: Go code matching the stub
findings.detail: Complete, compilable Go implementing func lengthOfLongestSubstring(s string) int.

findings.title: Empty string returns 0
findings.detail: s.length can be 0; the code returns 0 without special-case bugs.

findings.title: Complexity stated
findings.detail: States O(n) time and O(min(n, alphabet)) / O(1)-bounded extra space.

findings.title: Format: task line, code first
